title: Add grouping metadata to task write and display commands
description: Add --issue-id, --project, --milestone, --version, --feature-id, and --feature to canonical task create/update/edit and legacy create compatibility. Support explicit update clearing, reject blank create values after trimming, render populated fields in task detail output, preserve compact list/graph columns, and cover JSON plus human output. Keep featureId stable and feature display-oriented.
